experiments.paper_location: Sections 4.3-4.4: WTA sparsification, sparse forward/backward and updates
experiments.mechanism: Execute the same maintained production train_step operation control through a real SYCL CPU backend, with full-capacity delta reset and parameter-driven index rebuild.

conditions.oracle: independent scalar FP64 activations, probabilities, deltas, parameters, Adam moments/velocities, WTA bucket sets and active sets
negative_fixtures: production controller replay with reset disabled changes hidden deltas and actual parameters
stale index changes connected queried active set
conditions.execution: public shared-control SYCL Network::train on actual CPU device; native CUDA adapter not executed

experiments.note: Support adaptation with one hidden ReLU layer. Same controller is invoked by maintained native Network::train; runtime operations and reference numerical kernels remain backend-specific. Actual CPU USM/copy/clear, kernel submission, scan/filter/key-sort, row/column dense products, query, updates, buffer reuse and ordinary RAII teardown execute. CUDA source reset is wired but native confirmation/ownership/library/stream/race/performance acceptance stays #34/#43; no assertion that all original 54 host bodies ran.
